title: [review] provisioning.py:406: Session wiped before response
description: Session is wiped at line 406 BEFORE creating response at line 408. If ack.encode() fails (cbor2 error), exception propagates to line 299 returning INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR. But session including provisioned_identity is already wiped. Node loses its identity and cannot retry because the session no longer exists.
close_reason: Fixed by reordering operations: encode ACK before wiping session. If ack.encode() fails, session remains intact allowing retry.
